question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Full verification: top 5 customers by average monthly change with their names
WITH monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           date_trunc('month', payment_date) AS payment_month,
           SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_changes AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           payment_month,
           monthly_total,
           monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) AS month_change
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.customer_id,
       AVG(wc.month_change) AS avg_monthly_change,
       COUNT(wc.month_change) AS num_changes
FROM with_changes wc
JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = wc.customer_id
WHERE wc.month_change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name, c.customer_id
ORDER BY avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 5
